AmendmentIndicator.name: Amendment Indicator
AmendmentIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the confirmation is an amendment of a previous confirmation.

MasterReference.name: Master Reference
MasterReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a group of individual orders, as assigned by the instructing party. This identifier links the individual orders together.

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Market in which the advised trade transaction was executed.

OrderDateTime.name: Order Date Time
OrderDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the order was placed by the investor or its agent.

ReceivedDateTime.name: Received Date Time
ReceivedDateTime.definition: Date and time the order was received by the executing party, for example, the transfer agent.

RequestedFutureTradeDate.name: Requested Future Trade Date
RequestedFutureTradeDate.definition: Future date at which the investor requests the order to be executed.|The specification of a requested future trade date is not allowed in some markets. The date must be a date in the future.

CancellationRight.name: Cancellation Right
CancellationRight.definition: Cancellation right of the investor with respect to the investment fund order.

FinancialInstrumentDetails.name: Financial Instrument Details
FinancialInstrumentDetails.definition: Investment fund class to which the investment fund order execution is related.

RequestedSettlementCurrency.name: Requested Settlement Currency
RequestedSettlementCurrency.definition: Currency requested for settlement of cash proceeds.

RequestedNAVCurrency.name: Requested NAV Currency
RequestedNAVCurrency.definition: Currency to be used for pricing the fund. This currency must be among the set of currencies in which the price may be expressed, as stated in the prospectus.

TotalSettlementAmount.name: Total Settlement Amount
TotalSettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money paid /to be paid or received in exchange for the financial instrument in the multiple order.

BulkCashSettlementDetails.name: Bulk Cash Settlement Details
BulkCashSettlementDetails.definition: Payment process for the transfer of cash from the debtor to the creditor.

SettlementCurrencyRule.definition: If BulkCashSettlementDetails is present, then Currency in IndividualExecutionDetails/SettlementAmount must be the same in all occurrences of IndividualExecutionDetails.

BulkCashSettlementDetailsRule.definition: Either one or more occurrences of IndividualExecutionDetails/CashSettlementDetails or BulkCashSettlementDetails may be present, but not both.

RequestedSettlementCurrencyRule.definition: If RequestedSettlementCurrency is present, it must be the same Currency as in all occurrences of IndividualExecutionDetails/SettlementAmount.
